name: Loupiac

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation in Entre-Deux-Mers, between the Garonne and Dordogne rivers. Loupiac covers one commune and makes sweet white wine from Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc, Sauvignon Gris and Muscadelle.
